decisive_spans.text: High-intensity areas in bilateral lenticular nucleus with lentiform fork sign

response.rationale: The presence of high-intensity areas in the bilateral lenticular nucleus with a lentiform fork sign and a lactate peak on MRS are highly specific for Leigh syndrome. While other conditions might share some symptoms, these imaging and metabolic findings are key to the diagnosis of Leigh syndrome.
